CodeBehindForm
Attribute VB_GlobalNameSpace = False
Attribute VB_Creatable = True
Attribute VB_PredeclaredId = True
Attribute VB_Exposed = False
Option Compare Database

Private Sub Form_Open(Cancel As Integer)
With Forms("Редактирование")
nulltxt = ",null as z1,null as z2,null as z3,null as z4"
flist = Replace(!fromlist, "[intin]", "intin")
flist = Replace(flist, ";", ",")
n = UBound(split(flist, ",")) + 1
If n < 5 Then flist = flist & Left(nulltxt, 11 * (5 - n))
diagr.RowSource = "select year," & flist & ",numb1120 from [" & !wname & "] where year>0 order by year;"
diagr.Requery
End With
End Sub
